Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Thank you for setting out the cost drivers behind your offer; we appreciate your transparency and want an agreement that supports our partnership both ways. We propose a modest adjustment to the unit price alongside a longer payment period, retaining the arrangement without an index clause, and welcome your feedback on that balance.

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 364.69, payment_days 90, index_clause None). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge the verified volume increase and have incorporated the resulting economies of scale into our calculation.

Our current Angebot is a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that extending payment terms to 90 days incurs financing costs that would necessitate a higher unit price.

To provide you with the most competitive rate, we propose maintaining the standard 30-day payment term at a reduced price of €369.02. As an alternative at standard terms, we offer a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We propose retaining your standard payment terms without an index clause, alongside a measured adjustment to your quoted unit price, to support a fair and stable agreement for both sides.

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 360.44, payment_days 30, index_clause None). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Please be advised that our binding offer remains a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

In accordance with our group guidelines, this quotation remains valid for 30 days. We trust these conditions align with your planning and remain at your disposal should you require further process confirmation.

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Thank you for confirming your position; we value our partnership and have retained your proposed payment terms without an index clause. We ask you to consider a modest unit price adjustment, keeping the requested move limited to support a straightforward internal approval.

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 365.8, payment_days 90, index_clause None). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your preference for 90-day payment terms. To support our partnership and facilitate your internal approval, we can reduce our price to €372.50 per unit. 

Our current offer comprises a price of €372.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this price reflects the financing costs associated with the extended payment period. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Thank you for your price concession and for explaining how the extended payment terms affect your unit price. We acknowledge your request for supporting figures, though we have no additional verified data to share here. In the spirit of our partnership, we propose a modest further unit-price adjustment while retaining the payment terms and leaving out an index clause.

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 366.43, payment_days 90, index_clause None). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your slight adjustment and can offer a further concession to €372.15 per unit. Please note that without additional verified data to substantiate your target price, our flexibility remains highly restricted. 

We have maintained the 90-day payment term as requested to support your internal processes. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Accordingly, our offer stands at a price of €372.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
